results.q: What is CPT in the hybrid program and how much does the CPT course cost?
results.answer:
**What is CPT in the hybrid program, and travel during CPT**
Curricular Practical Training (CPT) lets F-1 students gain work experience related to their major. The hybrid program has a required CPT component: each hybrid student must secure an approved internship or employment and stay continuously enrolled in the CPT course each term. The CPT course fee equals one credit hour of tuition. You may travel during CPT but cannot work while abroad; you need a travel signature on your I-20 to re-enter, valid for one year. [1]

Related: Tuition for international graduate programs [2]; SSN rules for hybrid CPT students [3]

results.q: How many days can I be unemployed on OPT?
results.answer:
**Do I need a job offer to apply for OPT?**
No, a job offer is not required to apply for OPT. During the 12-month OPT period you may be unemployed for a total of 90 days (cumulative). Having a job lined up helps you keep status and avoid exceeding the 90-day unemployment limit. See also DHS Study in the States: https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/students/work/applying-for-practical-training [1]

results.q: What GPA do I need to be admitted as a freshman?
results.answer:
**Undergraduate admission requirements**
Undergraduate admission is test-optional for most applicants, but you need a high school cumulative GPA of at least 2.75 to be eligible; some programs such as nursing and education require test scores. The average ACT is 22. Steps: complete the online application, submit materials for your student type (first-year, transfer, homeschool, dual enrollment, international), and apply for financial aid. Visit options: personal campus visit, Discover Day, or Arts Discover Day; Belhaven adds USD 1,000 to the first-year scholarship package if you visit or attend a Discover Day. The Belhaven Advantage: eligible traditional undergraduates may get fifth-year tuition for a second major or degree plus a full-tuition scholarship for an eligible online master's after graduation. Office of Admission: 601-968-5940, admission@belhaven.edu, Jimmy Hood Welcome Center, 855 Riverside Drive, Jackson, MS. [1]

Related: Undergraduate scholarships (2027-2028) [2]; Contact: Undergraduate Admission [3]
